messages:
Rina Kobayashi: we finally got a hang repro on A100 80GB in bench-lab :tada: happens ~2-6 min under mixed prefill/decode + streaming

Rina Kobayashi: command that hit it twice now:
```bash
# a100-80gb-4x, tp=4
export RW_RUNTIME_BUILD=runtime/main@9c2b1d8
export RW_MODEL=llama-70b-instruct
export RW_TP=4
export RW_ENABLE_STREAMING=1
export RW_PREFILL_DECODE_MIX=1
export RW_MAX_CTX=32768
export RW_CONCURRENCY=96
export RW_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=8192
export RW_SCHED_POLICY=v2

# keep nccl logs minimal for now
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN

./bench-lab run tp_mixed_workload.yaml --duration=15m --seed=1337 \
  --prompt-lens 64,256,2048,8192 \
  --decode-lens 16,128,512 \
  --streaming-clients 0.35
```

Noah Patel: nice. when it hangs, is it total wedge (no responses) or just a subset of streams timing out?

Rina Kobayashi: subset first: streaming requests start stalling, then queue depth ramps, then everything looks stuck. GPU util drops to ~0-5% on 2/4 ranks.

Sofia Ivanova: do you have scheduler stats? specifically pending_prefill vs pending_decode and any “collective pending” counters?

Rina Kobayashi: not yet. only coarse logs. i enabled `--log-level=debug` and saw repeated “waiting for tp step” lines but no structured reason

Hiro Tanaka: any NCCL errors in stderr? or just silence?

Rina Kobayashi: silence. no NCCL error. last log line repeats:
"tp: rank=2 waiting on barrier event" then nothing

Grace Kim: can you paste the last ~50 lines from one replica? even if it’s noisy

Rina Kobayashi: yep, from rank0 sidecar (trimmed):
```text
I0217 10:34:51.902 scheduler: admitted batch id=18421 prefill=12 decode=0 q_depth=41
I0217 10:34:51.908 tp: step=decode_iter=913 begin collectives=2
I0217 10:34:51.910 tp: nccl allreduce start stream=comm0 tag=AR_KV_SUM
I0217 10:34:51.912 tp: nccl allgather start stream=comm0 tag=AG_LOGITS
I0217 10:34:51.913 tp: waiting on event e=comm0_done for compute stream
I0217 10:34:52.105 scheduler: admitted batch id=18422 prefill=16 decode=0 q_depth=47
I0217 10:34:52.112 tp: step=decode_iter=914 begin collectives=2
I0217 10:34:52.112 tp: waiting on event e=comm0_done for compute stream
I0217 10:34:52.318 scheduler: admitted batch id=18423 prefill=16 decode=0 q_depth=55
I0217 10:34:52.318 tp: waiting on event e=comm0_done for compute stream
... repeats for ~90s ...
```

Yuki Sato: that “waiting on comm0_done” is suspicious. if compute stream is waiting on comm event and comm stream is never making progress, could be comm starvation or event recorded on wrong stream

Sofia Ivanova: also note it’s admitting *prefill only* batches while decode is stuck. if decode thread is blocked, fairness/backpressure might not kick in and we just keep filling the queue. smells like starvation.

Noah Patel: +1. if the scheduler keeps allocating to prefill stream(s), comm stream might be blocked behind other work depending on how we’re sequencing. do we do any cross-stream sync that could deadlock if prefill holds a mutex?

Hiro Tanaka: what’s GPU topology? 4x A100 on same node, NVLink? and is this with CUDA graphs on?

Rina Kobayashi: 4x A100-80GB SXM, NVLink yes. CUDA graphs = ON (default). i can rerun with graphs OFF to check

Grace Kim: please do. graphs can change stream capture constraints; we’ve been burned by “event recorded outside capture” leading to weird waits (even if no explicit error)

Rina Kobayashi: ok next run toggles:
- graphs OFF
- reduce concurrency to 64
- keep same mix

Marcus Reed: if you can keep the same seed and only toggle graphs, that’ll help me later for perf-canary regression

Rina Kobayashi: will do

Omar El-Sayed: we need better signals here. can you also enable the temporary tp debug counters? `RW_TP_DEBUG_COUNTERS=1` adds “inflight_collectives” to logs every 5s

Rina Kobayashi: sure. what’s the env name exactly?

Omar El-Sayed: `RW_TP_LOG_PROGRESS=1` on main, or `--tp-log-progress` flag if using launcher. sorry, naming is messy

Julian Moore: this is exactly what ENG-4823 is for. for quick triage: can we add a one-liner heartbeat per rank on a timer thread (no locks) just to see who’s alive?

Noah Patel: yes. let’s not block on perfect metrics. minimum viable:
- per-rank heartbeat ts
- current “tp_phase” label: prefill/decode/collective_wait
- scheduler q_depth (prefill/decode)

Sofia Ivanova: agreed. i’ll own adding `scheduler_queue_depth{type=prefill|decode}` and “admit blocked reason” (e.g. waiting_on_collective)

Omar El-Sayed: i can own “stall reason codes” for runtime logs (compute vs comms vs scheduler). will thread w/ Aisha for naming later

Julian Moore: i’ll take heartbeat + a simple “collective_seqno” counter per rank. also want to record last-enqueued collective op name (allreduce/allgather)

Hiro Tanaka: kernel side: i’ll ask Grace/Yuki to inspect the event ordering around comm0_done. might be a missing `cudaEventRecord` on comm stream or wrong stream passed in graphs mode

Grace Kim: yep, i can take that. if Rina can provide the exact build sha and whether `RW_COMM_STREAMS=1` etc, i’ll diff against last known-good

Rina Kobayashi: build sha is in cmd: runtime/main@9c2b1d8. also:
```bash
export RW_COMM_STREAMS=1
export RW_TP_OVERLAP_COMM=1
```

Yuki Sato: overlap_comm + graphs is a spicy combo. might be benign but could hide sync bugs

Noah Patel: hypothesis list so far:
1) scheduler starvation: decode/collective path not getting scheduled; queue keeps admitting prefill
2) comm stream/event ordering bug (esp under CUDA graphs capture)
3) NCCL collective mismatch (less likely if no NCCL error, but “silent stall” possible)

Sofia Ivanova: for (1) we should confirm whether decode thread is actually running. Rina can you attach `gdb` and grab thread backtraces when wedged? (even just top frames)

Rina Kobayashi: i can. it’s a container in bench-lab but i can `nsenter` and `gdb -p`. will try next hang

Marcus Reed: another datapoint: does hang reproduce if you disable streaming? client disconnect / cancellation sometimes triggers weirdness

Rina Kobayashi: streaming is part of the repro. i can try `RW_ENABLE_STREAMING=0` too to isolate

Hiro Tanaka: if you do capture NCCL debug, please use WARN/INFO only and for short windows. full TRACE can be huge + perf heavy

Rina Kobayashi: ack

Rina Kobayashi: update: graphs OFF run (same seed) still hung, but took longer (~11 min). last lines differ slightly:
```text
tp: nccl allgather start tag=AG_LOGITS
scheduler: admitted batch ... prefill=16
scheduler: admitted batch ... prefill=16
tp: waiting on event e=comm0_done
```
so not strictly graphs-only

Noah Patel: ok, that points more toward scheduling/backpressure + comm stream starvation rather than capture-specific

Sofia Ivanova: yep. if scheduler keeps admitting prefill-only while decode stuck, we might be holding shared resources (e.g., mutex around step coordination). i’ll look at the fairness logic around “prefill-heavy batches”

Julian Moore: action items:
- Julian: quick heartbeat + collective seqno (ENG-4823 subtask)
- Omar: stall reason tags + structured log template
- Sofia: scheduler queue depth + admit blocked reasons; investigate starvation
- Rina: collect backtraces at hang + capture `nvidia-smi dmon` and one replica log bundle
- Grace/Hiro/Yuki: audit event/stream ordering around `comm0_done`

Rina Kobayashi: works. i’ll drop artifacts in the drive doc once i have them (logs + gdb bt). pinging here when ready

Grace Kim: :thumbsup: please also note whether any ranks keep printing progress while others stop (rank divergence)

Rina Kobayashi: will do. on last run, rank1 kept emitting “admitted batch” logs but rank2/3 went quiet after the wait line

Noah Patel: that’s strong evidence of rank divergence leading to collective stall. priority is getting per-rank heartbeat + last collective op so we can correlate.

Sofia Ivanova: +1. thanks Rina. this is the first repro that matches the Dedicated hang signature from incident notes.

Hiro Tanaka: if we confirm divergence, we should also check KV cache compaction triggers under memory pressure. but one step at a time

Rina Kobayashi: yep. ok going to set up another run with slightly higher max_ctx to push memory and see if it accelerates.
